fate.natal.v1.sign.sun.cancer.text: Cancer gives the Sun a language of care and attachment. The source places value on familiar people and places, and the security they can offer.

fate.natal.v1.sign.sun.capricorn.text: Capricorn gives the Sun a practical measure of purpose. Being useful and contributing to something durable are central images.
